text.name: Fall of the Assad Regime
text.rules: Record "foothold lost". LIO spends 2 points. Until the end of this turn, points spent by SAE count 1 less, never below 1.
text.history: Syrian rebel forces took Damascus on 8 December 2024 and President Bashar al-Assad fled to Russia, ending more than fifty years of his family's rule; the future of Russia's air and naval bases in Syria became uncertain.
